title: AI Paper Lists - New Additions
description: Tracks newly-added papers across five curated AI-paper GitHub lists (dair-ai/AI-Papers-of-the-Week, masamasa59/ai-agent-papers, aimerou/awesome-ai-papers, CYHSM/awesome-neuro-ai-papers, dair-ai/ML-Papers-Explained). Fetches each README via the GitHub API and extracts one row per paper entry (title + link), keyed by arxiv id or url hash. A downstream saved search surfaces only the papers appearing for the FIRST time in 30 days -- the daily 'diff' -- and the local 122B ELI5-summarizes them. No auth. Powers the 'AI Paper Diffs' daily alert group.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
import re
import hashlib
import base64
from datetime import datetime, timezone

# ai_papers_github_lists -- Slice C1 (2026-06-23).
# Fetches the README of each curated AI-paper GitHub list via the GitHub
# API (api.github.com/repos/<repo>/readme returns base64 markdown; already
# allow-listed, so no raw.githubusercontent.com needed) and extracts one
# row per paper entry. The downstream feeder surfaces only papers appearing
# for the FIRST time in 30 days -- i.e. what was newly ADDED to the lists --
# and the local 122B ELI5-summarizes them. Every row of a run shares ONE
# _epoch so the first-seen dedup works (same pattern as github_trending_repos).
#
# Title extraction handles the format variety across lists:
#  - [Title](arxiv)             -> title is the link text (aimerou, CYHSM)
#  - **"Title"** [[paper](url)]  -> link text is "paper"; title is the bold
#                                   span on the line (masamasa59)
#  - [Name](medium-url)          -> explainer entries (ML-Papers-Explained)
# dair-ai/AI-Papers-of-the-Week's README is a newsletter pointer (its papers
# are not in the README), so it yields ~0 entries -- expected and fine; the
# other lists carry the signal.

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
now_epoch = int(now.timestamp())
discovered_iso = now.isoformat()

EXPECTED_COLUMNS = [
    'paper_key', 'title', 'url', 'link_text', 'source_repo', 'source',
    'discovered_iso', '_epoch',
]

REPOS = [
    'dair-ai/AI-Papers-of-the-Week',
    'masamasa59/ai-agent-papers',
    'aimerou/awesome-ai-papers',
    'CYHSM/awesome-neuro-ai-papers',
    'dair-ai/ML-Papers-Explained',
]
PAPER_DOMAINS = [
    'arxiv.org', 'openreview.net', 'aclanthology.org',
    'semanticscholar.org', 'huggingface.co/papers', 'medium.com',
]
GENERIC = [
    'paper', 'papers', 'code', 'link', 'links', 'pdf', 'arxiv', 'project',
    'page', 'blog', 'video', 'slides', 'demo', 'website', 'homepage',
    'github', 'repo', 'dataset', 'data', 'here', 'read', 'more',
]
HEADERS = {'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json', 'User-Agent': 'SpeakesQuery-Ingest'}

rows = []
seen = set()
for ri in range(len(REPOS)):
    repo = REPOS[ri]
    try:
        resp = requests.get('https://api.github.com/repos/' + repo + '/readme', headers=HEADERS, timeout=30)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        md_text = base64.b64decode(resp.json().get('content', '')).decode('utf-8', 'replace')
    except Exception:
        continue
    lines = md_text.splitlines()
    for li in range(len(lines)):
        line = lines[li]
        if 'http' not in line:
            continue
        found = re.findall(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\((https?://[^)\s]+)\)', line)
        if not found:
            continue
        paper_url = ''
        paper_text = ''
        for fi in range(len(found)):
            lurl_low = found[fi][1].lower()
            is_paper = False
            for di in range(len(PAPER_DOMAINS)):
                if PAPER_DOMAINS[di] in lurl_low:
                    is_paper = True
                    break
            if is_paper:
                paper_url = found[fi][1]
                paper_text = found[fi][0]
                break
        if not paper_url:
            continue
        am = re.search(r'arxiv\.org/(?:abs|pdf)/(\d{4}\.\d{4,6})', paper_url.lower())
        if am:
            key = 'arxiv:' + am.group(1)
        else:
            key = 'url:' + hashlib.sha1(paper_url.lower().rstrip('/').encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()[0:16]
        if key in seen:
            continue
        clean_text = re.sub(r'[\[\]\*"]', '', paper_text).strip()
        if clean_text and clean_text.lower() not in GENERIC and len(clean_text) >= 2:
            title = clean_text
        else:
            bm = re.search(r'\*\*(.+?)\*\*', line)
            if bm:
                title = re.sub(r'[\*"]', '', bm.group(1)).strip()
            else:
                tmp = re.sub(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\((https?://[^)\s]+)\)', '', line)
                title = re.sub(r'[\*#"]', '', tmp).strip().lstrip('-* ').strip()
        if len(title) > 250:
            title = title[0:250]
        if not title:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        rows.append({
            'paper_key': key,
            'title': title,
            'url': paper_url,
            'link_text': paper_text[0:100],
            'source_repo': repo,
            'source': 'github_ai_papers',
            'discovered_iso': discovered_iso,
            '_epoch': now_epoch,
        })

if rows:
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)
else:
    df = pd.DataFrame(columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)

GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
